name: Canagliflozin
description: A sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor approved for type 2 diabetes and diabetic nephropathy. Its SGLT1 cross-activity distinguishes it within the class.

systems.note: Lowers glycaemia by increasing urinary glucose loss; the intended metabolic effect, placed on the pancreas as the glycaemic system.
Diabetic nephropathy progression reduction is a labelled indication.
Bone mineral density loss and fracture risk are labelled for this agent.
Acute kidney injury and hyperkalaemia are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled renal indication and acute kidney injury signal.
Bone density loss is labelled specifically for this agent.
